description: Start here for any question about moving to, living in, retiring in, investing in or getting residency, citizenship or a second passport in Latin America, Spain, Portugal or Italy. One search across everything this server holds: countries, residency/visa/citizenship programs, cities (safety and cost of living), private clubs, golf courses, sovereignty projects, nomad events, MyLatinLife services, articles and videos. Every result has an id; pass it to fetch for the complete sourced record. Call with no arguments for an overview of coverage, topics, row counts, verification dates and how to cite. Use find_visas instead when you need numeric filters (income, investment, physical presence, years to citizenship).

country.description: Only results for this country. Country name or slug, e.g. "Panama" or "costa-rica".

kind.description: Only this kind of result (topic: one subject of one country, such as its banking or military service). counts in every answer shows how many matched of each kind.

limit.description: How many results to return. Defaults to 20.

query.description: The question in plain words, or keywords: e.g. "retire on $2,000 a month in South America", "Italian citizenship through grandparents", "does Colombia have military service", "golden visa", "safest cities Mexico". Results come best match first; a named country or region filters, and an amount also runs find_visas. Omit with no other arguments for the overview.

name: search
title: Search MyLatinLife data
